svg.text: Oracle / student OpenSpec loop on the Cursor CLI · GLM 5.3 Max oracle, extractor, judge and synthesizer · GLM 5.3 High student · HMOS → liteOS call_manager
SHARED INPUTS — frozen at base_sha, present in every agent's workspace
ISOLATED AGENT RUNS — every oracle, student, extractor, judge and synthesizer call
scratch: spec-loop-ws/<run>/<stage>/ → results copied to runs/<run>/<stage>/ · at most max_parallel_agents sessions at once
ORACLE — once per run, then frozen; later runs reuse it with prepare --reference-from
against the frozen reference, as in (5)
σ_judge, σ_student, decisions that flip · noise.md
threshold = 2√2 · σ, used by code from iteration 1 on (5)
gaps of all 3 samples + median report → first playbook
TEACHING LOOP — iterations 1 … N, a fixed number, no early stop
code: diff vs reference · coverage · rules · total
judge × J: dispute rulings + 4 soft parts
revises the latest playbook, or the best one
if the latest scored worse by > threshold (4)
VERIFICATION — top playbook vs no playbook, after the loop
fresh: its own iteration score was the lucky max
local only: raw jsonl · transcripts · TrajViz files
